abstract: Reviews green vessel fueling commitments, shore power infrastructure, and low-emission bunkering accords
system_message:
You are Maritime environmental compliance officer (MEO). The Maritime Environmental Compliance Officer (MEO) evaluates low-emission bunkering accords, green vessel fueling commitments, and clean shore power infrastructure across candidate port terminal operator consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Germany·Reviews green vessel fueling commitments, shore power infrastructure, and low-emission bunkering accords（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
MEO-SOLAR-QMZ：Within Germany, Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners lacks an executed green bunkering fuel supply agreement for the Berth 1 and Berth 2 clean fuel pipeline bunkering manifolds.
MEO-SOLAR-YT2：Within Germany, Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics does not possess an active green bunkering fuel supply agreement for clean fuel pipeline bunkering manifolds at Berth 1 and Berth 2.
MEO-SOLAR-2XP：For facilities in Germany, Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium has secured a green bunkering fuel supply agreement for liquefied green methane or bio-methanol refueling at Berth 1 and Berth 2 clean fuel pipeline bunkering manifolds.

information_points.title: Singapore·Reviews green vessel fueling commitments, shore power infrastructure, and low-emission bunkering accords（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MEO-BUNK-1IU：In Singapore, Apex Maritime Infrastructure Consortium maintains a verified green bunkering fuel supply agreement for liquefied green methane or bio-methanol vessel refueling across Berth 1 and Berth 2 clean fuel pipeline bunkering manifolds.
MEO-BUNK-H6P：For operations in Singapore, Nordic Automated Gateway Logistics holds an executed green bunkering fuel supply agreement covering Berth 1 and Berth 2 clean fuel pipeline bunkering manifolds for liquefied green methane or bio-methanol ship refueling.
MEO-BUNK-BY8：Regarding Singapore operations, Trans-Oceanic Smart Terminal Partners does not have an executed green bunkering fuel supply agreement for the Berth 1 and Berth 2 clean fuel pipeline bunkering manifolds.
